A complete table owns 251658240 bytes for 40 gate/up and down layer pairs. Matching immutable sources copy metadata into the original request scratch. Model release invalidates source identities before freeing weights; new registration drains readers before rebuilding. Partial failures never publish a table and retain owned allocations for drained cleanup.
